spells.name: Arcane Dart
spells.description: Fires a sharp dart of concentrated arcane power at the target, dealing direct damage.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.description: Hurls an explosive sphere of demonic flame that incinerates foes.

spells.name: Arcane Shield
spells.description: Conjures a shimmering protective barrier that absorbs incoming physical and magical attacks.

spells.name: Cleanse
spells.description: Channels pure energy to purge negative debuffs and restore physical health.

spells.name: Blink
spells.description: Instantly teleports the caster a short distance across the battlefield or room.

spells.name: Summon Sylph
spells.description: Weaves atmospheric currents into a sentient Sylph wind-elemental companion.

spells.name: Summon Ignis
spells.description: Ignites raw volcanic energy into an Ignis flame-elemental companion.
